english_title: Properties of the Trace of a Linear Operator
statement_en: For linear operators $\mathscr{A},\mathscr{B}$, the trace satisfies: 1. $$\text{trace}(\mathscr{A}\circ \mathscr{B})=\text{trace}(\mathscr{B}\circ \mathscr{A}).$$ 2. $$\text{trace}(a\mathscr{A}+b\mathscr{B})=a\,\text{trace}(\mathscr{A})+b\,\text{trace}(\mathscr{B}),$$ where $a,b$ are constants.
final_code:
import Mathlib

theorem linearMap_trace_comp_comm
    {K V : Type*}
    [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module K V]
    [Module.Free K V]
    [Module.Finite K V]
    (A B : Module.End K V) :
    LinearMap.trace K V (A.comp B) = LinearMap.trace K V (B.comp A) := by
  sorry

theorem linearMap_trace_linear_combination
    {K V : Type*}
    [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V]
    [Module K V]
    [Module.Free K V]
    [Module.Finite K V]
    (A B : Module.End K V)
    (a b : K) :
    LinearMap.trace K V (a • A + b • B) =
      a * LinearMap.trace K V A + b * LinearMap.trace K V B := by
  sorry
